description: Get results from a previous ClaimHit search by search ID, and narrow, sort and page through them. FREE and unlimited: every call is a view over results already paid for, so filter and re-read as much as the conversation needs. A search completes in phases: check the returned `status` field and call again if it is RUNNING, because background enrichment keeps finding additional implementers for several minutes after the first results appear. Only present results as final when status is COMPLETE. Results are paged — if the response carries a `more` field, there are further matches and you must not present the page you have as the complete list.

company.description: Only return targets whose company (or standards body) contains this text, case-insensitive. E.g. "Bosch", "Samsung".

detail.description: full adds the per-element scores, the evidence source and the stored evidence passages for each target — use it when asked why something scored as it did. Reading evidence is free; a Hit Chart is the paid, element-by-element analysis.

include_held_low.description: Also return candidates held back for re-verification (not findings yet, flagged held_low). Default false.

offset.description: Skip this many matching targets. Use the offset the previous response's `more` field tells you, to page through the whole list.

query.description: Only return targets whose name, company or description contains this text, case-insensitive. Use for narrowing by technology or market words.

risk.description: Risk bands to return. Omit for the default list (HIGH and MEDIUM, plus any target found via forward citations and any product the user named). Pass ["LOW"] to see the low-confidence leads, which are excluded by default.

search_id.description: The search ID returned from claimhit_search or claimhit_get_history

sort.description: default = the same order the ClaimHit app shows (documented evidence coverage, then company size); score = Hit Score highest first; name = alphabetical.

name: claimhit_get_result
title: Get full search results
